_**Agent (gpt-6-astra 2026-09-24 17:51:55Z)**_

Claude 這台是 `2.1.281`，已支援 `--settings '<JSON>'`；官方文件也說它會合併單次設定，優先於專案設定。這讓一次性 proxy 注入有機會不再暫寫 `settings.local.json`。[Claude 設定說明](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings)

退出同步的重點則是「等 agent 程序結束」，不能只監聽 Ctrl+C：TUI 可能把 Ctrl+C 當按鍵處理，也可能先取消工作、第二次才退出。SpecStory 另有獨立的 `watch`，可供需要即時存檔時使用。[SpecStory CLI](https://docs.specstory.com/integrations/terminal-coding-agents/usage)

Use when a user wants somewhere to record \"maybe later\" ideas, freeze troubleshooting state, capture trade-off analysis, or stop re-debugging the same problem.\n---\n\n# project-knowledge-harness\n\nA lightweight, file-based memory harness for any software project.\n\nThree surfaces, sharply separated by **time direction** and **access pattern**:\n\n| Surface | Time | Question it answers | Access pattern |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `TODO.md` | Future | \"What might we do later?\" | Read top to bottom (priority lanes) |\n| `backlog/<slug>.md` | Future | \"What was the analysis behind this idea?\" | Indexed from `TODO.md` |\n| `pitfalls/<slug>.md` | **Past** | **\"I see error X — has this happened before?\"** | **Grep symptom keywords** |\n\nPlus, in projects that already have agent contracts, `AGENTS.md` Hard\ninvariants answer \"What rules MUST agents follow?\". Pitfalls *graduate* to\nHard invariants when serious enough — see\n[`references/when-to-add-docs.md`](references/when-to-add-docs.md).\n\n## When to use this skill\n\nUse this skill when the user surfaces any of:\n\n- A long-term TODO list with no home, or a messy `TODO.md` that needs\n  structure (signals: \"where should ideas go?\", \"maybe later\", \"工程量太大需要再評估\")\n- A debugging session worth saving (signals: \"keep solving the same problem\n  twice\", \"save this troubleshooting\", \"踩過的坑\", \"TROUBLESHOOTING.md\n  scattered across docs/\")\n- A request to consolidate `IDEAS.md` / `ROADMAP.md` / `WISHLIST.md` /\n  `LESSONS.md` files\n\nDo NOT use this skill for active sprint planning (use issue trackers),\nephemeral agent scratchpads (use `.claude/plans/`), or current feature\ndocumentation (use `docs/`).\n\n## How to apply this skill (default workflow)\n\nThe skill bundles five scripts and several templates. **Default to the\ninit script** for setup, and **default to `add-todo.sh` / `sweep-inbox.sh`\nfor capture** rather than asking the agent to edit `TODO.md` by hand.\n\n```\nscripts/\n  init.sh         # one-shot setup of TODO.md + backlog/ + pitfalls/\n                  # + agent guidance + README snippet\n  todo-kanban.sh  # validate TODO.md format and render kanban-style board\n  add-todo.sh     # insert a structured entry into the right ## P* lane\n  promote-todo.sh # move an active TODO item to ## Done with the right syntax\n  sweep-inbox.sh  # triage backlog/inbox.md into TODO.md via add-todo.sh\n```\n\n### 1. +            while time.monotonic() < deadline:

text(await tools.apply_patch(String.raw`*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/zhouhanru/.local/share/chezmoi/pitfalls/codex-project-config-provider-ignored.md
+# Project config parses successfully but Codex still uses the original provider
+
+**Symptoms**: `Ignored unsupported project-local config keys`; project
+`model_provider` / `model_providers` have no effect although `debug models` succeeds.
+**First seen**: 2026-09
+**Affects**: Codex CLI 0.156.1, observed on macOS arm64
+**Status**: version-specific limitation; use invocation-level overrides, retest after upgrades
+
+## Symptom
+
+A trusted temporary Git project contained a custom provider pointing at a local
+mock endpoint. `codex debug models --bundled` returned JSON successfully.
+An actual `codex exec --ephemeral --json` launch never reached that endpoint and
+emitted this exact warning (the temporary test path is retained for searchability):
+
+```text
+Ignored unsupported project-local config keys in /private/var/folders/xz/b1n4y0mn3lj6qs5ydgypj2r80000gn/T/tmp90_yrmqh/project/.codex/config.toml: model_provider, model_providers. If you want these settings to apply, manually set them in your user-level config.toml.
+```
+
+It then attempted the original OpenAI provider. No real credentials or user
+configuration were used in the probe.
+
+## Root cause
+
+Project config support does not mean every configuration key is allowed at that
+scope. The CLI filters provider selection/definitions as host-owned settings.
+A bundled-model catalog dump is not a runtime routing check, so it supplied
+misleading confidence during planning.
+
+Claude's `.claude/settings.local.json` is also not an exact analogue of Codex's
+project config: Codex has no separate `config.local.toml` override layer.
+
+## Workaround
+
+Use `codex-copilot-once` (or its identical `codex-copilot` spelling). It supplies
+the provider with invocation-level `-c` options and leaves ordinary new Codex /
+SpecStory launches on their existing provider. `copilot-here codex on` explains
+the limitation and does not write a ineffective pin or modify user-wide routing.
+
+Keep legitimate shared project configuration available for version control.
+Ignoring a tracked file does not make a private provider overlay safe.
+
+## Prevention and upgrade retest
+
+This is **not** a permanent claim that Codex can never support project providers.
+Before implementing a persistent Codex project pin after an upgrade:
+
+1. Record the exact CLI version and use isolated HOME, CODEX_HOME and Git project
+   directories; explicitly trust only that temporary project's canonical path.
+2. Put the provider definition/selection only in the project's config.
+3. Use dummy credentials and a localhost mock, with outbound network blocked.
+   Run an actual foreground session; a parser/catalog-only check is insufficient.
